tattered.linePrev: They went flying around in the rain
tattered.line: And their feathers once so fine grew torn and tattered
tattered.lineNext: And in the end they traded their tired wings
stanza: Some of them knew pleasure
Some of them knew pain
And for some of them it was only the moment that mattered
And on the brave and crazy wings of youth
They went flying around in the rain
And their feathers once so fine grew torn and tattered
And in the end they traded their tired wings
For the resignation that living brings
And exchanged love's bright and fragile glow for the glitter and the rouge
And in a moment they were swept before the deluge

partner.line: And for some of them it was only the moment that mattered

tattered.linePrev: There came a man of fortune, a drifter passing by
tattered.line: He wore a torn and tattered cloth around his leathered hide
tattered.lineNext: And a coat of many colors, yellow-green on either side
stanza: Once amid the soft silver sadness in the sky
There came a man of fortune, a drifter passing by
He wore a torn and tattered cloth around his leathered hide
And a coat of many colors, yellow-green on either side

tattered.linePrev: And you, all sibylline, reclining in your pew
tattered.line: You tattered me, you tethered me to you
tattered.lineNext: The things you would, and the things you wouldn't do
stanza: And I, seventeen and terminally fey
I wrote it down and threw it all away
Never gave a thought to what I'd paid
And you, all sibylline, reclining in your pew
You tattered me, you tethered me to you
The things you would, and the things you wouldn't do
To tell the truth I never had a clue

tattered.linePrev: And the flower lady hobbles home without a sale
tattered.line: Tattered shreds of petals leave a fading trail
tattered.lineNext: Not a pause to hold a rose
stanza: And the flower lady hobbles home without a sale
Tattered shreds of petals leave a fading trail
Not a pause to hold a rose
Even she no longer knows
The lamp goes out, the evening now is closed
And nobody's buying flowers from the flower lady
